_header.regenerate_after_cutover: legacy golden is captured at SHA ddb9eb971da145ba46a4800735f7c6670d2eb6db or earlier; if the fixture is missing, regenerate from that SHA (git worktree add ../lt-golden ddb9eb971, copy this test in, run with UPDATE_GOLDENS=1), never from post-cutover code.

entry_points.daily_tasks: allDailyTasksProvider composition: projection + chazara, completion filter, priority sort; no skips, no snapshot cache

_header.divergence_policy: projection_tasks must match exactly in every scenario. chazara_tasks and daily_tasks must match exactly in every scenario except chazara_due, whose chazara_tasks (and hence daily_tasks) may be marked an intentional divergence only where reviewsDue(today) semantics differ; document it in DNI-477.

conventions.dates: Dates are civil YYYY-MM-DD. The legacy planner is fed each civil date as an instant at 12:00Z.
conventions.learnt: learnt rows are first-stage (learn, stage_order 1) completions with a real learned_on date; no before_tracking / bulk-prior sentinel rows.
conventions.track: tracking_start_date is the track activatedAt; no reorder (lastReorderAt null), no custom learning order, no program enrollment, no sub-tracks.
conventions.track_label: track_label comes from the production seam (curriculumLabelTextFromRef, as injected by allDailyTasksProvider) with display toggles pinned to useHebrewTerms=false, transliteration=ashkenazi. shared_inputs.track_label_by_display_setting freezes the seam under every toggle combination.

scenarios.description: Pace goal 3/day, tracking since 3 days ago. The child caught up on the first 6 mishnayos today; the rest of the 2 missed days is behind pace and today's 3 are due — all inside Orlah.
FR-12a transition day. Pace goal 3/day, tracking since 11 days ago, all 33 scheduled mishnayos learnt. Today's batch finishes Orlah (3:8, 3:9) and begins Bikkurim (1:1).

Deadline goal 2026-06-24 (10 study days incl. today) over the 74-leaf scope, tracking since 2 days ago, 10 mishnayos learnt. The legacy planner derives 56/week (8 per study day) from the deadline; 6 are behind pace and today's 8 are due, inside Orlah.
Pace goal 2/day, tracking since 5 days ago, learnt on pace (2 per day, 06-10 .. 06-14). Today's 2 are due; chazara A is overdue for everything learnt before yesterday and due today for yesterday's 2.
